text: This report provides information requested by City Council on the number of solid waste trucks used in parks, where the trucks are required to drive on the turf to pick up waste in parks, and the estimated costs from the Parks and Recreation budget to repair turf. Solid Waste Management Services provides waste collection services to approximately 1,175 parks across the city with a total fleet of 33 small waste collection vehicles. In most parks, waste can be collected without entering the park or by staying on paved pathways within the park. In certain situations, Solid Waste Management Services operators are required to temporarily drive off the paved surfaces to access waste bins and / or to avoid pedestrians and cyclists using the paved paths.
